videos.title: Rabies isn't trying to kill - it's trying to control!
videos.author: MinuteEarth
videos.description: Rabies is a strange disease, it travels through the nerves and tries to take control of the brain. The changes in behavior make the creature more likely to spread the disease!

videos.title: Why are the biggest animals herbivores?
videos.author: MinuteEarth
videos.description: The bigger an animal is, the more calories it needs to sustain itself - the easiest way to do that is by eating small things like leaves, plants, and krill.

videos.title: Why Are Some People Mosquito Magnets?
videos.author: MinuteEarth
videos.description:
Some people just seem to be mosquito magnets; in one scientific study, 20 percent of the people ended up with 95 percent of the mosquito bites! So if you’ve ever thought mosquitoes had it out for you specifically, you might be right. And now, we know why.

videos.title: Why do bees dance?
videos.author: MinuteEarth
videos.description: Bees use the waggle dance to tell other bees about the location and quality of flower patches. A starred review - for bees.
